propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml installs and tests files that are redundantly covered by the matrix test cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 on ubuntu and macOS), consuming a scarce GitHub Actions job slot against the org's 20-slot cap.

Deletion of the import-linter job alone creates a visibility gap: existing workflow parity checks cannot detect the loss of test collection for test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py, risking future contributors adding markers that silently drop coverage.

A durable pytest collection test must assert that test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py are collected under the default suite selection (not integration, not external) to serve as a checked-in guard.

The collection guard must be sensitive to marker additions anywhere (file-level pytestmark, decorators, or conftest-applied marks) to catch regressions that would otherwise silently escape wiring-level checks.
